briefing: Manifest first: sealed transport crates, state guard chain of custody, no exceptions. This is {PATRON}, colonel of the state guard at {HERE}.
You carry the manifest to the drop point, you see the transporter through to safe range after, and you finish the Asp marked for the guard's justice. The order does not change once given.
Follow the order as given. The state pays for compliance, not for good intentions.

manifest.arrive: Take the manifest to {TARGET} and collect {PAY} on delivery
manifest.success: Manifest delivered to {TARGET}; the state credits {PAY} at once
manifest.fail: Manifest undelivered at {TARGET}; the state voids {PAY} and the contract

guard.arrive: See the transporter into station range at {TARGET} for {PAY}
guard.success: Transporter secured at {TARGET}; the state holds {PAY} ready
guard.fail: Transporter lost before {TARGET}; the state withdraws {PAY}

wreck.arrive: Scoop the transporter's cargo adrift at {TARGET} for {PAY}
wreck.success: Cargo recovered at {TARGET}; the state keeps {PAY} on the books
wreck.fail: Cargo unrecovered at {TARGET}; the state cancels {PAY}

purge.arrive: Destroy the Asp last seen at {TARGET} and collect {PAY}
purge.success: Asp accounted for near {TARGET}; the state closes with {PAY}
purge.fail: Asp unaccounted near {TARGET}; the state cancels {PAY}

dossier.lead: A tight-band signal from {PATRON} reaches the commander, routed through {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Traders mutter that {PATRON}'s state guard at {WORLD} still wants a courier for a live contract.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word direct: the manifest waits at {WORLD}, no excuses.

dossier.news: State guard postings at {WORLD} confirm {PATRON} is hiring a pilot for an active contract.

story.opening: The commander took the colonel's contract at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: The commander closed the colonel's contract out of {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
closing.fail: The commander's contract with {WORLD} collapsed on day {DAY}.

manifest.success: On day {DAY}, the commander delivered the manifest to {WORLD}.
manifest.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander failed to deliver the manifest to {WORLD}.

guard.success: On day {DAY}, the commander guided the transporter safely into {WORLD}.
guard.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the transporter was destroyed short of {WORLD}.
guard.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the transporter jumped clear of {WORLD}.
guard.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander lost the transporter before {WORLD}.

wreck.success: On day {DAY}, the commander scooped the transporter's cargo near {WORLD}.
wreck.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the transporter's cargo was destroyed before {WORLD}.
wreck.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander failed to recover the cargo near {WORLD}.

purge.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the commander destroyed the Asp near {WORLD}.
purge.targetEscaped: On day {DAY}, the Asp escaped near {WORLD}.
purge.targetFled: On day {DAY}, the Asp fled before {WORLD}.
purge.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander failed to run down the Asp near {WORLD}.

dossier.title: The Colonel's Reckoning
